Added s13: asserts shipped interpreter reports required/enum errors with JSON pointers (/nodes/0/evidence, /edges/0/type), throws 'unsupported type' on unknown type, and that every type in the three schemas is supported by it. node --test tests/schema.test.mjs: 13/13 pass; full node --test: 44/44 pass, exit 0.
outcome.descriptive: Schema tests now exercise the same JSON Schema interpreter validate.mjs ships, so the two can no longer drift.
